title: ConFIT: A Robust Knowledge-Guided Contrastive Framework for Financial Extraction

contributions.purpose: 提升金融文本多实体情感归因与数值敏感性的鲁棒抽取
contributions.mechanism: 知识引导对比学习框架ConFIT,用Semantic-Preserving Perturbation(SPP)引擎(实体替换/数值调整/上下文重排)结合Loughran-McDonald词典与Wikidata,经perplexity与NLI过滤生成hard negatives
contributions.evaluation: 在FiQA/SENTiVENT上用FinBERT与Llama-3 8B评测,部分配置F1达1.0
contributions.source_quote: we propose ConFIT (Contrastive Financial Information Tuning), a knowledge-guided contrastive learning framework that employs a Semantic-Preserving Perturbation (SPP) engine to generate high-quality, programmatically synthesized hard negatives.

contributions.purpose: 揭示训练中的过拟合与超参敏感陷阱
contributions.mechanism: 跨训练轮数(10/15/20)观察F1与loss曲线
contributions.evaluation: F1快速收敛到1.0但loss在>10 epoch后回升,呈明显过拟合,需early stopping
contributions.source_quote: while some configurations reach an F1-score of 1.0, longer training (beyond 10 epochs) leads to evident overfitting

contributions.evaluation: Synthetic Multi配置出现验证F1=0.000 vs 训练F1=0.611的异常,作者自认负样本生成模块存在缺陷
contributions.source_quote: The anomaly in the Synthetic Multi configuration (a validation F1 score of 0.000 versus a training F1 score of 0.611) is particularly striking and suggests a defect in the negative generation module.

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our work builds on these contributions by using a knowledge-guided negative generation mechanism and carefully analyzing pitfalls in model training.

notes: AI披露checklist全部[D]。数据可信度红旗:多配置F1=1.0(过拟合/疑数据泄漏信号),且Synthetic Multi出现val F1=0.000 vs train F1=0.611的极端异常,作者自认为负样本生成模块defect;全篇无量化结果表,结论靠图1-4曲线。trade-off:>10 epoch过拟合需early stopping。desk-reject。
